decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 10.2	Erection of a single storey side extension to house, as shown on drawing numbers, GT/002, GT/005, GT/006 & GT/007, received 23 May 2006 & GT/003 Rev A & GT/004 Rev A, received 17 July 2006, would not harm the architectural or historic character or the setting of the listed building, would maintain the amenity of neighbouring properties and is considered to preserve and enhance the appearance and character of Grove Park Conservation Area. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas, ENV-B.2.5 Development Affecting the Setting of a Listed Building, ENV-B.2.7 Alterations to Listed Buildings and Buildings of Local Townscape Character, and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations, and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No development involving any amendments to the construction or materials of the extension hereby permitted that are necessary to meet Building Regulations shall be undertaken until details are submitted to an approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Erection of a single storey side extension to house.
